This is the minutes of a mixed general meeting of ARCHEAN TECHNOLOGIES held 19 January 2017. The AGM allocated a deficit to reserves, then authorized (subject to suspensive conditions: bank financing and absence of creditor opposition) a capital decrease of up to €150,861 via buyback-and-cancellation of shares held by minority shareholders, reducing capital from €368,102 to €217,241, and gave powers to the President to execute it. No realization of the decrease is recorded in this document.</summary_en>
